_about: The Parker Society's collective volumes, which have no single author: liturgies, prayer collections, letter collections, poetry and the General Index (Cambridge, 1842-1855). The name check here looks for the Society's own name ('Parker Society', printed in every volume; 'Parker' alone also matched any book naming the archbishop), not an author's. The authored Parker volumes have their own shelves (cranmer, latimer, ... whitgift). Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

ps-select-poetry-2.author: Title page read 2026-10-03: collected and edited by Edward Farr for the Parker Society, part 2, Cambridge 1845. The Society's name is printed in blackletter and OCR'd as 'Barker', so the name check cannot see it.
ps-select-poetry-2.title: The title words 'Select Poetry, chiefly Devotional' are also blackletter on the title page and OCR as '* Icct €!)tcfln Qcbotianal'; the page itself, read by eye, carries them. The volume continues part 1 (Thomas Tusser onward).

ps-epistolae-tigurinae.author: Latin volume: its title page names the Society in Latin ('Parkerianae Societatis', OCR 'Parkertanae Societatis') and the English wrapper OCRs as 'he Parker Soctetz'; neither OCR form is 'Parker Society'. Checked by eye 2026-10-03.
